toolkit.name: Pipedrive
toolkit.description: Pipedrive is a sales management tool built around pipeline visualization, lead tracking, activity reminders, and automation to keep deals progressing

tools.name: Add a deal
tools.description: Add a new deal to Pipedrive with any custom fields, which vary by account and are identified by long hash keys. Check dealFields for existing custom fields. For details, visit the tutorial on adding a deal.

status.title: Status
status.description: Status of the deal (open, won, lost). Defaults to open

user_id.title: User Id
user_id.description: ID of the user who will be marked as owner of this deal

currency.title: Currency
currency.description: Currency for the deal value (3-letter ISO code)

person_id.title: Person Id
person_id.description: ID of the person this deal is linked to

visible_to.title: Visible To
visible_to.description: Visibility of the deal (owner, entire company etc)

expected_close_date.title: Expected Close Date
expected_close_date.description: Expected close date in format YYYY-MM-DD

tools.name: Add a note (Deprecated)
tools.description: DEPRECATED: Use PIPEDRIVE_PIPEDRIVE_ADD_NOTE instead. Add a note to a deal, person, organization, lead, or project in Pipedrive. At least one of deal_id, person_id, org_id, lead_id, or project_id must be provided.

org_id.title: Org Id
org_id.description: The ID of the organization this note will be attached to. Required unless one of (deal_id/person_id/lead_id/project_id) is specified.

content.title: Content
content.description: The content of the note in HTML format. Subject to sanitization on the back-end.

deal_id.title: Deal Id
deal_id.description: The ID of the deal the note will be attached to. Required unless one of (lead_id/person_id/org_id/project_id) is specified.

lead_id.title: Lead Id
lead_id.description: The ID of the lead the note will be attached to (UUID format). Required unless one of (deal_id/person_id/org_id/project_id) is specified.

add_time.title: Add Time
add_time.description: The optional creation date & time of the note in UTC. Format: YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS

person_id.title: Person Id
person_id.description: The ID of the person this note will be attached to. Required unless one of (deal_id/lead_id/org_id/project_id) is specified.

project_id.title: Project Id
project_id.description: The ID of the project the note will be attached to. Required unless one of (deal_id/person_id/org_id/lead_id) is specified.

tools.name: Add a person
tools.description: Add a new contact in Pipedrive with optional custom fields unique to each account found using the `personFields` endpoint. The endpoint also handles `data.marketing_status` for Campaigns product users.

name.title: Name
name.description: The name of the person. REQUIRED by Pipedrive API.

items.title: ContactItem

label.title: Label
label.description: Label for the item (e.g., work, home)

primary.title: Primary
primary.description: Whether this is the primary item

items.description: Email/Phone item schema used by Pipedrive v1 for persons.

email.title: Email
email.description: List of email objects: { value: string, label?: string, primary?: bool }

label.title: Label
label.description: Label for the item (e.g., work, home)

primary.title: Primary
primary.description: Whether this is the primary item

items.description: Email/Phone item schema used by Pipedrive v1 for persons.

phone.title: Phone
phone.description: List of phone objects: { value: string, label?: string, primary?: bool }

owner_id.title: Owner Id
owner_id.description: ID of the user who will be marked as the owner of this person

label_ids.title: Label Ids
label_ids.description: IDs of labels to assign to the person

visible_to.title: Visible To
visible_to.description: Visibility of the person (e.g., 1=owner only, 3=entire company)

marketing_status.title: Marketing Status
marketing_status.description: Marketing status (no_consent, unsubscribed, subscribed, archived). Field is available only when Campaigns is enabled.

tools.name: Add an activity
tools.description: New activity added. Response includes `more_activities_scheduled_in_context` to show if more are planned with the same entity. See tutorial on adding activities [here](https://pipedrive.readme.io/docs/adding-an-activity).

done.title: Done
done.description: Whether the activity is done (0 = not done, 1 = done)

type.title: Type
type.description: The type of the activity (matches ActivityTypes.key_string)

deal_id.title: Deal Id
deal_id.description: ID of the linked deal (integer or numeric string)

lead_id.title: Lead Id
lead_id.description: ID of the linked lead (UUID string)

user_id.title: User Id
user_id.description: ID of the user who owns the activity

attendees.title: Attendees
attendees.description: Attendees of the activity (contacts or external emails)

busy_flag.title: Busy Flag
busy_flag.description: Whether the activity marks the assignee as busy

public_description.title: Public Description
public_description.description: Public description synced to external calendar

tools.name: Add an organization
tools.description: Creates a new organization in Pipedrive. The 'name' parameter is required and represents the organization's name (e.g., 'Acme Corp'). Optionally specify 'owner_id' to assign an owner and 'visible_to' for visibility settings. Custom fields can also be added using field keys from organizationFields.

name.title: Name
name.description: The name of the organization to create (required). This is typically a company or business name such as 'Acme Corp' or 'Tech Solutions Inc.'

tools.name: Bulk add products to deal
tools.description: Tool to bulk add products to a Pipedrive deal. Use when attaching multiple products simultaneously, with maximum 100 products per request.

id.title: Id
id.description: The ID of the deal to which products will be attached

items.title: ProductItem

is_enabled.title: Is Enabled
is_enabled.description: Whether product is active; defaults to true

billing_frequency.title: Billing Frequency
billing_frequency.description: Billing cycle (one-time, monthly, etc.); Growth+ plans only

billing_start_date.title: Billing Start Date
billing_start_date.description: Start date in YYYY-MM-DD format; Growth+ plans only

items.description: Product item to be added to a deal

data.title: Data
data.description: Array of product objects to attach to the deal. Maximum 100 products per request.

tools.name: Add a lead
tools.description: Pipedrive API lets you add leads linked to people or organizations and tags them with 'API' source. Custom fields from deals apply to leads and appear in responses if set. Details are in the tutorials for adding and updating leads.

owner_id.title: Owner Id
owner_id.description: The ID of the user which will be the owner of the created lead. If not provided, the user making the request will be used.

was_seen.title: Was Seen
was_seen.description: A flag indicating whether the lead was seen by someone in the Pipedrive UI

label_ids.title: Label Ids
label_ids.description: The IDs of the lead labels which will be associated with the lead

person_id.title: Person Id
person_id.description: REQUIRED if organization_id is not provided. The ID of a person which this lead will be linked to. If the person does not exist yet, it needs to be created first. At least one of person_id or organization_id must be set.

organization_id.title: Organization Id
organization_id.description: REQUIRED if person_id is not provided. The ID of an organization which this lead will be linked to. If the organization does not exist yet, it needs to be created first. At least one of person_id or organization_id must be set.

expected_close_date.title: Expected Close Date
expected_close_date.description: The date of when the deal which will be created from the lead is expected to be closed. In ISO 8601 format: YYYY-MM-DD.

tools.name: Add Note
tools.description: Tool to add a note to a deal, person, organization, lead, or project in Pipedrive. Use when you need to create a note attached to an entity. At least one entity ID (lead_id, deal_id, person_id, org_id, or project_id) must be provided.

org_id.title: Org Id
org_id.description: The ID of the organization to attach the note to. At least one of lead_id, deal_id, person_id, org_id, or project_id must be provided.

content.title: Content
examples: This is a note about the deal
content.description: The content of the note in HTML format. Subject to sanitization on the back-end.

deal_id.title: Deal Id
deal_id.description: The ID of the deal to attach the note to. At least one of lead_id, deal_id, person_id, org_id, or project_id must be provided.

lead_id.title: Lead Id
lead_id.description: The ID of the lead to attach the note to (UUID format). At least one of lead_id, deal_id, person_id, org_id, or project_id must be provided.

user_id.title: User Id
user_id.description: The ID of the user who will be marked as the author of the note. Only admins can change this.

add_time.title: Add Time
add_time.description: The creation timestamp for the note in UTC. Format: YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS

person_id.title: Person Id
person_id.description: The ID of the person to attach the note to. At least one of lead_id, deal_id, person_id, org_id, or project_id must be provided.

project_id.title: Project Id
project_id.description: The ID of the project to attach the note to. At least one of lead_id, deal_id, person_id, org_id, or project_id must be provided.

pinned_to_deal_flag.title: Pinned To Deal Flag
pinned_to_deal_flag.description: If set to 1, the note will be pinned to the deal. 0 or omit to not pin.

pinned_to_lead_flag.title: Pinned To Lead Flag
pinned_to_lead_flag.description: If set to 1, the note will be pinned to the lead. 0 or omit to not pin.

pinned_to_person_flag.title: Pinned To Person Flag
pinned_to_person_flag.description: If set to 1, the note will be pinned to the person. 0 or omit to not pin.

pinned_to_project_flag.title: Pinned To Project Flag
pinned_to_project_flag.description: If set to 1, the note will be pinned to the project. 0 or omit to not pin.

pinned_to_organization_flag.title: Pinned To Organization Flag
pinned_to_organization_flag.description: If set to 1, the note will be pinned to the organization. 0 or omit to not pin.

tools.name: Add a product
tools.description: Adds a new product to the Products inventory. For more information, see the tutorial for adding a product.

items.title: ProductPrice

id.title: Id
id.description: Unique identifier of the price

product_id.title: Product Id
product_id.description: ID of the product this price belongs to

owner_id.description: Owner user ID; if omitted, authorized user ID is used

is_linkable.description: Whether the product can be added to a deal

billing_frequency.description: Billing frequency (one-time, annually, semi-annually, quarterly, monthly, weekly)

billing_frequency_cycles.title: Billing Frequency Cycles
billing_frequency_cycles.description: Number of billing repeats (rules depend on billing_frequency)

tools.name: Convert Lead to Deal
tools.description: Tool to convert a Pipedrive lead to a deal asynchronously. Use when you need to convert an existing lead into a deal. The conversion transfers all related entities (notes, files, emails, activities) to the new deal. Upon successful conversion, the lead is marked as deleted. Use the returned conversion_id to check the conversion status.

input.title: ConvertLeadToDealRequest

id.title: Id
id.description: The ID of the lead to convert (UUID format)

stage_id.title: Stage Id
stage_id.description: The ID of a stage the created deal will be added to. The pipeline will be assigned automatically based on the stage_id. Do not use both pipeline_id and stage_id together.

pipeline_id.title: Pipeline Id
pipeline_id.description: The ID of a pipeline the created deal will be added to. The deal will be added to the first stage of the specified pipeline. Note: pipeline_id will be ignored if both pipeline_id and stage_id are provided.

input.description: Request model for converting a lead to a deal.

tools.name: Update deal product
tools.description: Tool to update product details attached to a deal in Pipedrive using the v2 API. Use when you need to modify product attributes like price, quantity, discount, or tax for a deal-product attachment.

id.title: Id
id.description: The ID of the deal

discount.title: Discount
discount.description: Discount value - amount or percentage based on discount_type (default: 0)

is_enabled.title: Is Enabled
is_enabled.description: Whether product is active/enabled for the deal. Note: API v2 uses strict validation - only accepts true/false, not 1/0.

tax_method.title: Tax Method
tax_method.description: Tax application method - 'exclusive' (tax not included in price), 'inclusive' (tax included in price), or 'none' (no tax)

billing_frequency.title: Billing Frequency
billing_frequency.description: Billing cycle option for Growth+ plans - 'one-time', 'annually', 'semi-annually', 'quarterly', 'monthly', or 'weekly'

billing_start_date.title: Billing Start Date
billing_start_date.description: When billing commences (Growth+ plans). Format: YYYY-MM-DD

product_attachment_id.title: Product Attachment Id
product_attachment_id.description: The ID of the deal-product attachment (correlation ID between deal and product, obtained from GET /deals/{id}/products). This is NOT the same as the product_id.

billing_frequency_cycles.title: Billing Frequency Cycles
billing_frequency_cycles.description: Number of billing frequency repetitions (Growth+ plans)

tools.name: Get all leads
tools.description: The API returns sorted leads by creation time, supporting pagination via `limit` and `start`. Custom field values are included if set, mimicking the `Deals` endpoint structure; unset fields are omitted. Leads share custom fields with deals.

sort.title: Sort
sort.description: The field name and sorting mode. Format: 'field_name ASC' or 'field_name DESC'. Valid field names: id, title, owner_id, creator_id, was_seen, expected_close_date, next_activity_id, add_time (creation timestamp), update_time. Note: Use 'add_time' for creation time (NOT 'creation_date'). Only first-level field keys are supported (no nested keys).

limit.title: Limit
limit.description: For pagination, the limit of entries to be returned. If not provided, 100 items will be returned.

start.title: Start
start.description: For pagination, the position that represents the first result for the page

owner_id.title: Owner Id
owner_id.description: If supplied, only leads matching the given user will be returned. However, `filter_id` takes precedence over `owner_id` when supplied.

filter_id.title: Filter Id
filter_id.description: Optional ID of a saved filter to apply. Filter IDs are account-specific and must be obtained from the user's Pipedrive account using the 'Get all filters' endpoint (GET /filters with type='leads'). Do not pass placeholder values like 1. When filter_id is provided, it takes precedence over owner_id, person_id, and organization_id parameters. If omitted, returns all leads without filtering.

person_id.title: Person Id
person_id.description: If supplied, only leads matching the given person will be returned. However, `filter_id` takes precedence over `person_id` when supplied.

archived_status.title: ArchivedStatusEnm
archived_status.description: Filtering based on the archived status of a lead. If not provided, `All` is used.

organization_id.title: Organization Id
organization_id.description: If supplied, only leads matching the given organization will be returned. However, `filter_id` takes precedence over `organization_id` when supplied.
